Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with Universalis and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.51

- Keep approved NPC-sale departure state for the whole retainer visit, including remaining listings, and restore it when choosing Quit.

Changelog:

Author: Jacob5800
Name: Workshoppa
Description: Automates workshop material turn-ins, retainer deposits and voyage collection/redeployment for company airships and submarines, with optional repairs and per-vessel routes.
Changelog:
- Separate vessel routes and optimisation into tabs, with a scrollable recommendation list and collapsible build details.
- Add submarine gil-profit/hour estimates using locally cached Universalis average sale prices, background refreshes, adjustable tax and running-cost allowances, and NPC fallback values.

Changelog:
## 0.2.0.7

Author: Tataru-business
Name: Keybound Automation
Description: Reads Keybound Brawler prompts and answers with keyboard input. Open /tatarubrawler for the Keybound Automation interface. Auto queue on lobby entry repeats until Stop auto queue; the circular arrows start a counted manual loop. Diagnostic recording, automatic play, and play on MapID 1359 are enabled at startup.
Punchline: Automatically type Keybound Brawler prompts and optionally keep queueing.
Changelog: - Add Open Keybound Coffers with a Start/Stop button in Quick Controls. Opens carried coffers one at a time, waits for each cast and inventory update, and stops when finished or inventory space is unavailable.

Author: Lily; Jacob5800 (BiSplanner fork)
Name: BiSplanner
Description:
Highlights gear, coffers, and materia needed for all your gearsets
Import from from Etro, Xivgear, or Teamcraft for easy setup

Highlights items needed for gearsets on:
    - Need/Greed Loot Windows
    - NPC Shops and Exchanges
    - Marketboard
    - Player Inventories
    - Item Tooltips

When melding materia, highlights:
    - Items to meld
    - Materia to meld to item

Automatically syncs gearsets with player inventory
Changelog:
## 0.3.0.5

- Show currency icons and green/red purchase costs according to your available balance, with owned and required amounts on hover.
- Label currency purchase options with the item they buy to distinguish base gear costs from upgrade materials.
- Show known source instances beneath unowned gear and prerequisites.
- Show owned item locations in inventory, armoury chest and equipped gear, plus last-seen saddlebag and retainer snapshots refreshed when their inventories are opened. Remote snapshots are saved separately for each character.

Author: Jacob5800
Name: Roll Knockout
Description: Count unique player rolls, track highest and lowest, and announce elimination rounds.

Changelog: - Rename to Roll Knockout with a separate plugin identity so it appears alongside the official DeathRoll plugin. Open with /rollknockout.
